To preserve the batteries and to make sure continuously that they are fit for service, the monthly periodic inspection must be carried out to avoid the accumulation of faults on them and thus to preserve the required efficiency.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Saad Mahmoud Mohamed Bassiouni, reviewed by Eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Naggar of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, Middle Delta Electricity Production Company, approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control, and approved by Accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, Head of the Financial Planning and Forecasting Sector and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Issue an approved work order, with the maintenance team holding the appropriate Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Smoking is prohibited in the battery room.
No flammable materials inside the battery room.

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | All Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: B-055-r0a | Equipment: Lead-acid batteries
Issued to: Generation companies
Status: Approved
Date of approval: 13 June 2006 | Procedure: Monthly maintenance (I2-M1)
Date of next review: June 2011
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the monthly maintenance of liquid (flooded) batteries. To preserve the batteries and to make sure continuously that they are fit for service, the monthly periodic inspection must be carried out to avoid the accumulation of faults on them and thus to preserve the required efficiency.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Saad Mahmoud Mohamed Bassiouni, reviewed by Eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Naggar of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, Middle Delta Electricity Production Company, approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control, and approved by Accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, Head of the Financial Planning and Forecasting Sector and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Occupational Safety and Health Precautions
Issue an approved work order, with the maintenance team holding the appropriate Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Smoking is prohibited in the battery room.
No flammable materials inside the battery room.
Use the appropriate protective clothing.
Issue an approved work order, with the maintenance team holding the appropriate Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Smoking is prohibited in the battery room.
No flammable materials inside the battery room.
Use the appropriate protective clothing.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Suitable tools to check the soundness of the connections
Suitable hydrometer (acid concentration measuring instrument)
Distilled water
Suitable cleaning tools and cleaning materials
Cleaning tools for floors and batteries
Suitable protective clothing
Procedure to be Carried Out
Make sure the connections are sound and the cable terminals are tightly fastened, with great care | 1.
Use the battery cleaning equipment and the room floor | 2.
Make sure the battery room is well ventilated | 3.
Check the battery levels against the permitted limit | 4.
Measure the specific gravity of the batteries in which a fall in level was observed | 5.
Top up with distilled water the batteries whose level has fallen, after adjusting them | 06
Record the monthly observations on the batteries whose level has fallen or which have been adjusted. | 07
